description: Verify that the existing build and tests for the queryparser module pass before making any changes. This confirms the baseline is green.
steps: Set up JDK 25 environment: JAVA_HOME=$(mise where java@25) PATH=$(mise where java@25)/bin:$PATH
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/lucene && ./gradlew :lucene:queryparser:compileJava :lucene:queryparser:compileTestJava --no-daemon -q to confirm compilation works

Run: cd /projects/sandbox/lucene && ./gradlew -p lucene/queryparser test --tests TestSimpleQueryParser --no-daemon -q to verify the SimpleQueryParser test passes (this is the closest pattern to what we will build)
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/lucene && JAVA_HOME=$(mise where java@25) PATH=$(mise where java@25)/bin:$PATH ./gradlew :lucene:queryparser:compileJava :lucene:queryparser:compileTestJava --no-daemon -q
cd /projects/sandbox/lucene && JAVA_HOME=$(mise where java@25) PATH=$(mise where java@25)/bin:$PATH ./gradlew -p lucene/queryparser test --tests TestSimpleQueryParser --no-daemon -q
findings: Baseline verified successfully. JDK 25.0.2 works. Compilation of queryparser (main + test) passes. TestSimpleQueryParser passes. Gradle caches are warm. INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network is fine since no external downloads needed after initial cache.
